newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas ends mixed, fronts down with cash.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas ends mixed, fronts down with cash.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures ended mixed Tuesday in another sluggish session, with some profit taking and short covering holding prices above early lows but front months losing some ground with cash.
July slid 1.8 cents to close at $2.122 per million British thermal units. August settled 0.9 cent lower at $2.155. Other months ended narrowly mixed, with 1999s up slightly.

"It still looks like there's more downdside, but there were a lot of people taking profits on shorts which helped hold it up," said one Midwest trader, noting hot weather this week was mildly supportive but expected to be short-lived.

While hot Midwest and Northeast temperatures this week should help stem any physical or paper slide, traders said more seasonal weather later this week and next could rouse the bears, particularly with the Southeast and Texas not expected to stray far from normal during the period.
Early injection estimates for Wednesday's weekly AGA storage report range from 85 bcf to 110 bcf. For the same week last year, stocks gained 88 bcf.

Technical traders said ranges remained intact, with July support still pegged at $2.10 and stronger buying expected at $2.08. Resistance was seen first at $2.21, then at $2.25, $2.37 and the contract high at $2.44.

In the cash, swing gas in the Louisiana Gulf slipped a couple of cents Tuesday to the mid-teens. Oklahoma pipes were down a similar amount to about $2. New York city gate gas was several cents lower in the low-$2.40s despite the heat there.
The NYMEX 12-month Henry Hub strip fell by 0.8 cent to $2.229. NYMEX said 30,445 contracts traded, up slightly from Monday's revised tally of 28,679.

On the KCBT, July finished three cents lower at $1.985, while deferreds ended down by one-half to two cents. The East/West spread widened by 1.2 cents to 13.7 cents (NYMEX premium). KCBT said 520 lots traded, up sharply from Monday's total of 197.
